name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 29 times in 12 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 58 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-08-11, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.83 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
